text: Pursuant to 38 U.S.C. 8127(l)(2), the offeror certifies that in the case of a contract for services (except construction), the contractor will not pay more than 50% of the amount paid by the the government to it to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs listed in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219-73 or certified VOSBs listed in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219-74; in the case of a contract for general construction, the contractor will not pay more than 85% of the amount paid by the government to it to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs listed in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219-73 or certified VOSBs listed in the in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219-74; and in the case of a contract for special trade contractors, the contractor will not pay more than 75% of the amount paid by the government to it to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs listed in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219-73 or certified VOSBs listed in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219-74. For all such contracts, any work that a similarly situated certified SDVOSB/VOSB subcontractor further subcontracts will count towards the respective subcontracting percentage limit that cannot be exceeded. For service contracts (except construction), other direct costs may be excluded to the extent they are not the principal purpose of the acquisition and small business concerns do not provide the service as set forth in 13 CFR 125.6.
